about: Verdicts on findings from tools/recipe-consistency.js, written with tools/consistency-ledger.js. Each recipe entry carries the fingerprint of the content it was reviewed against; when the recipe changes, its verdicts go stale and the findings come back. Statuses: exception (the recipe is right and the checker misread it), duplicate (covered by another finding), cooking (needs a real cook to settle), specialist (needs qualified safety review). Only exception and duplicate close a finding; the other two stay in the open list, counted on their own.

stages-exceed-cook|stages.reason: The 3-hour simmer for the jelly is started first and runs while the pastry is made (60 minutes of prep) and the pie bakes (25 + 80 minutes); the jelly is then strained and chilled while the pie cools for at least 3 hours. The method now says so. The cook time is the bake; the total includes the 3 hours of cooling and the 4 hours of setting.

The beef (50 minutes), the rice (30) and the pepper sauce (10 + 1 + 5 + 25) are cooked side by side, and the method now says so ("While the beef cooks", "Meanwhile"). The longest chain is the beef and the final 10-minute simmer: 60 minutes, the row's cook time.
The 2-hour steam in the last step reheats the pudding on the day it is served, after it has matured; it is not part of making it. The cook time is the 6-hour steam.

stages-exceed-cook|stages.reason: The method runs three tracks at once and now says so: the ragù (8 + 8 + 2 + 2 minutes, the wine reduced, 30 to 35 minutes simmering) is made while the aubergine salts (30 minutes, counted as waiting) and roasts (25 minutes), with the potatoes on a second tray alongside; the béchamel is made while the ragù simmers. The cooking path is the 25-minute roast and the 45 to 50-minute bake: 70 to 80 minutes in the row and cookMax. The checker adds every stage in sequence because only the first sentence of each parallel step starts with "while".
